rule: Isolated single foreground (2) cells are erased to background. Every multi-cell glyph keeps its cells and is recoloured by the symmetry of its cropped mask: up-down mirror symmetric becomes 1, left-right mirror symmetric becomes 3, and symmetric only about a main or anti-diagonal of its square bounding box becomes 6. No glyph is both UD and LR.
scope: Mirror-symmetry glyph recolouring with isolated noise deletion; procedural connected masks in feasibility-conditioned spatial slots. Includes square axial and reversed-aspect axial glyphs, up to 12 glyphs and 30 noise cells, fixed 10..30 rectangular canvases.
constraints: All 5 canonical examples and 1000 independent archived-solver seeds pass. Independent coordinate-set reflection oracle passes 1756 distinct scenes, including 441 canvas shapes, 100 dense 14x14 nine-glyph scenes, all six backgrounds and maximum counts.

8635 glyphs cover 2848 UD, 2875 LR, 2912 diagonal; 2311 square axial and 2095 reversed-aspect axial glyphs defeat bounding-box shortcuts.8389 noise pixels removed. Largest observed glyph: 12 wide, 11 high, 54 cells.
16 malformed/infeasible controls reject. Critic: 24 valid / 8 rejection cases pass. No 80-trial mask fallback observed in targeted checks.
Default scene always has >=2 noise pixels and >=2 symmetry classes; fixed count/kinds controls checked.
known_limitations: Finite constructive domain: foreground 2, backgrounds 0/4/5/7/8/9, 4-connected glyphs also isolated under 8-connectivity, bounding boxes separated by background.
Glyphs both UD/LR, asymmetric glyphs, touching objects, other foreground colours excluded. Symmetry mask span capped at 12, with diagonal span 9.
After 80 failed growth trials, a small class-correct template fallback remains; none observed in targeted checks, but future dataset audits should count actual use.
Slot layout and high-count requests constrain glyph size; larger canvases do not guarantee harder reasoning. Explicit one-glyph/no-noise scenes are broader than fixtures.

authored_scope:
Supported in random scenes:
- Grid sides 12..30 by default, or 10..30 when the caller fixes them.
- Background from {0,4,5,7,8,9}.
- 3..9 glyphs, scaled with area, or exactly 1..12 via num_shapes or a kinds list.
- At least 2 noise pixels (2..3+area//100), or exactly 0..30 via num_noise.
- All three symmetry classes:
  - UD glyphs up to 9x12, LR glyphs up to 12x9, D glyphs square 3..9.
  - D glyphs can be symmetric about the main diagonal or the anti-diagonal.
  - Square-bbox UD/LR distractors, tall UD and wide LR glyphs.
  - Even-length mirror axes.
  - Stroke-like grown masks with holes.

Glyphs are placed in a random R x C slot partition sized to the canvas, so any glyph count within the packing bound is constructible without retries. Explicit scenes (shapes/noise) reproduce the fixtures and are fully validated.

Deliberately not supported:
- Glyphs that are both UD and LR, or have no symmetry.
- Two-cell objects.
- Noise inside a glyph bbox.
- Touching objects.
- Foreground colours other than 2.
authored_constraints: Every glyph is 4-connected, its crop is at least 3x3, and it has exactly one class: UD and not LR, LR and not UD, or a square diagonal-symmetric mask that is neither UD nor LR.
In random scenes, glyph bounding boxes are separated by at least one background row or column (slot gaps), so 4- and 8-connected components coincide.
Noise pixels lie outside every glyph bounding box and have no other foreground in their 8-neighbourhood.
In explicit scenes, no foreign object cell may lie inside any glyph bounding box, so cropped masks are pure.
Background stays the strict majority colour. Output colours 1, 3 and 6 are disjoint from the background and from 2.
Random scenes with 2 or more glyphs contain at least two symmetry classes, unless the caller supplies kinds.
num_shapes must be at most ((h+1)//4)*((w+1)//4), and num_noise at most ((h+1)//2)*((w+1)//2). Violations raise ValueError immediately.
Malformed controls raise ValueError: bad kinds, masks, noise entries, bools, out-of-range ints, or random-only controls mixed with explicit shapes.
The output is derived from the latent glyph kinds. Symmetry checks only validate consistency.
